items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Rod played clarinet with us and he was one of the great clarinet players... We called it the Art Hodes Columbia Quintet, featuring Rod Kless

ctx.x: And we thought it was a terrible thing to do. But it turned out that it was one of the best dates we ever made, we ever made at that time.
Did you know Rod Kless here?

Yes, Rod Kessel on clarinet. And Rod and I -- again, did you know that Rod K... had been married to Bud Freeman's sister? This I did know, and I think they had a child and they broke up. And, yes, Rod played clarinet with us and he was one of the great clarinet players because, again, the simplicity of his playing.
